A repository made by desktop restic on plain FAT32, which no job of the app knows. Browsed to with the Files picker: a folder without a repository reads "No backups found", a wrong password is refused, the right one mounts it. The Files app lists it and opens a snapshot; every file of both snapshots reads back by SHA-256, one from its middle; a write is refused. Unmount and mount again; pulling the drive takes the backup with it and disables Create schedule. Host: the drive is byte for byte as it was.
